title: Template Lab onboarding asset map and orientation strip
creator: Ava Chen
description: Goal: Produce a consolidated asset map and annotated orientation strip for the Template Lab quickstart that can be shipped with the README and the template app itself. Deliverables: (1) Orientation strip — a horizontal sequence of 4 branded screens (Welcome, Connect API key, Run sample, Inspect output) with microcopy variants for Desktop/Mobile, (2) README diagrams — 5 annotated SVGs showing flow (install -> run -> debug -> metrics -> next steps), (3) Exported screenshot pack in required formats and densities (PNG @1x/@2x, WEBP for web, and Figma source), (4) Microcopy and alt-text set for accessibility and localization pass, (5) Asset naming and publishing checklist for the engineering handoff. Scope/constraints: Keep visuals compact (screenshot dimension target: 1280x720 for desktop hero, 540x960 for mobile), avoid showing actual API keys in screenshots (use placeholder strings), follow brand tokens (primary/gray/neutral) and new iconography set. This ticket coordinates with ENG-5012 (embed sample-run telemetry hook) and PM acceptance criteria in PM-3382.
